caption: The same 7 sites, 1 head office plus 6 branches, drawn twice. In the top row only the head office writes, so the write share is 1/7 ≈ 14.3% even though all 7 hold copies; in the bottom row all 7 validate, so the share is 7/7 = 100% with 7 ledger copies.

spec.title: 1 head office + 6 branches = 7 sites
spec.aria: Two rows of the same 7 sites: before, only the head office writes while the 6 branches hold read-only copies; after, all 7 sites validate writes on a shared ledger.
